T: A head for business. An appetite for dinner.
D: A Staten Island secretary takes over her boss's deal while the boss is laid up.
P: Serve the mains when Tess crashes the Trask wedding to talk business.
S: Staten Island ferry egg and cheese rolls
Tess's commute on the Staten Island ferry every morning

Soft rolls with buttery folded eggs, melted cheddar and crisp bacon, a dash of hot sauce, wrapped in foil for the ferry. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and pepper and cook gently in 20g butter, folding into soft curds. Split and butter 4 soft rolls, toast cut side down. Fill with eggs, 4 slices cheddar and bacon, add a dash of hot sauce, wrap in foil and rest 2 minutes so the cheese melts.
prawn on cucumber, and she's not invited
Thick cucumber rounds topped with a poached prawn, a dot of Marie Rose and a sprig of dill, served cold on trays.
the big pitch in the boardroom
Golden crab cakes bound with a little mayo and breadcrumb, with lemon and a quick tartare.
M: Seared sirloin sliced over cos with blue cheese, cherry tomatoes and red onion, red wine vinaigrette.
Tess's own neighbourhood, a long way from Wall Street

Crumbed chicken fried golden, topped with marinara, mozzarella and parmesan and grilled until bubbling, with buttered spaghetti. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Coat in flour, beaten egg, then 120g breadcrumbs mixed with 30g parmesan. Shallow-fry 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked. Top each with 3 tbsp marinara and 50g sliced mozzarella and grill 3 minutes until bubbling. Simmer 400g passata with garlic and basil for the marinara. Serve with 320g spaghetti tossed in butter.
W: Vanilla butter cake split and layered with raspberry jam and Swiss meringue buttercream, chilled and cut in tall slices.
K: the ferry in from Staten Island
Bourbon stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters, served up with a cherry. Stir 60ml bourbon, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes bitters with ice for 30 seconds.

s.note: prawn on cucumber, and she's not invited
s.how: Poach 300g green prawns for 2 minutes, chill and peel. Cut 2 cucumbers into thick rounds. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp tomato sauce. Top each round with a prawn, a dot of sauce and a dill sprig and serve cold on a tray.

s.note: the big pitch in the boardroom
s.how: Mix 400g crab meat, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, chopped parsley and 60g breadcrumbs. Shape 12 small cakes, chill 20 minutes and pan-fry in butter for 3 minutes a side. Serve with lemon wedges and 150g tartare sauce.

m.how: Sear 2 large sirloins hard, rest and slice thin. Toss 2 heads cos with 250g halved cherry tomatoes and thin red onion. Whisk 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 6 tbsp oil and Dijon. Top with the steak and 100g crumbled blue cheese.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, then beat in 250g butter. Layer with raspberry jam and chill.

d.note: the ferry in from Staten Island
d.how: Stir 60ml bourbon, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes bitters with ice for 30 seconds. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and drop a maraschino cherry in each.
